data.action: 侧卧在纯白真丝床榻上，翠绿长发如瀑散落枕畔，单手轻抵心口，金眸在清冷月色与床头微光中柔和凝视
data.description: 洁白无瑕的真丝床榻上，C.C.优雅地侧卧其中。如瀑布般的翠绿长发在纯白枕被上肆意流淌，泛着如玉光泽的肌肤在柔和光影中若隐若现。她一手轻抚在胸前，另一手自然枕在脸侧，金色眼眸中翻涌着漫长岁月未曾有过的温存依恋，微启双唇发出轻柔温和的微叹。
data.lighting: 白纱帘透进来的朦胧银白月色
data.location: 拉上白纱帘的私密主卧纯白大床
data.nsfwProse: Unclothed beneath the loosely drawn white silk sheet, her bare shoulders, collarbone, smooth back, and slender legs catch the cool silver moonlight.
data.promptProse: On a quiet white silk bed washed in window moonlight and a soft bedside rim light, C.C. reclines on her side with one arm folded beneath her cheek and her other palm resting lightly against her chest, meeting the viewer's eyes with rare, unguarded warmth.
data.title: C.C. · 纯白床榻的深情仰卧交付
data.animaCaption: Lying nude on her side across smooth white silk bedsheets with the sheet draped low over her waist, she pillows her head on one arm and rests her other hand gently over her heart while gazing softly at the viewer in blended moonlight and bedside glow.
